info.title: Avoca Enterprise API
info.description: Read-only programmatic access to Avoca data: calls, transcripts, leads, coach evaluations, Simple Scheduler sessions and analytics, and outbound texting activity.

tags.name: Calls
tags.description: Call records, transcripts, and pre-call transfers

tags.name: Leads
tags.description: Unified leads (v0) and the canonical leads feed (v1)

tags.name: Teams
tags.description: Teams accessible to the API key

tags.name: Scheduler Analytics (v0)
tags.description: Simple Scheduler analytics — legacy flat endpoints

tags.name: Sessions & Bookings
tags.description: v1 scheduling-widget sessions and completed bookings

tags.name: Analytics (v1)
tags.description: v1 funnel, UTM, service-area, and issue-type analytics

tags.name: Outbound Texting
tags.description: Campaign text and subscription-event feeds for BI ingestion

get.description: List calls for the authenticated team. The exact columns returned are governed by the team's configured column allowlist. Requires the `read:calls` permission.
Get a specific call by ID. Requires the `read:calls` permission.
Get the transcript for a specific call. Requires the `read:transcripts` permission.

200.description: The transcript as ordered role/content turns

get.summary: Get latest call by phone number
get.description: Get the most recent call for a phone number. Requires the `read:calls` permission.

List inbound calls that were forwarded to a configured destination *before* the AI agent picked up, based on the team's pre-call transfer rules. These calls have `duration_seconds: 0` because the AI never engaged. Returns a fixed shape and does not honor the team's column allowlist. Requires the `read:calls` permission.

parameters.name: rule_types
parameters.description: Comma-separated rule types to filter by. One or more of: `REJECTED_AGENT_PREVIOUSLY`, `RECENT_CALLER`, `UPCOMING_APPOINTMENTS`, `RECENT_APPOINTMENTS`, `CUSTOMER_TYPE_RESIDENTIAL`, `CUSTOMER_TYPE_COMMERCIAL`, `CALLER_PHONE_MATCH`, `CALL_REASON_MATCH`, `CUSTOMER_TAG_MATCH`.

get.description: Channel-touchpoint aggregation of leads across calls, the scheduling widget, web chat, text, and Google LSA. This is **not** the canonical leads record and does not include the raw third-party payload — for that, use the v1 leads feed (`GET /api/v1/teams/{teamId}/leads`). Requires the `read:leads` permission.
List the teams the API key can access. For multi-team keys, all accessible teams; for single-team keys, the one team. Requires the `read:teams` permission.

List evaluated coach (QA) calls for the team, newest first. Each row includes the score, awarded/max points, per-item evaluation answers, and the `rubric_id` for joining to `GET /api/coach/rubrics`. Requires the `read:coach` permission.
Get a single evaluated coach call by its numeric ID. Requires the `read:coach` permission.
Reference endpoint: lists the team's enabled rubrics. Items provide the key → name mapping for the `evaluation_answers` keys returned on coach calls. Requires the `read:coach` permission.

200.description: Enabled rubrics with item key/name pairs

get.description: Detailed Simple Scheduler analytics. Select which metric blocks to include with the `metrics` parameter: `funnel`, `bookings`, `chart`, `utm`, `google_ads`, `service_areas`, `issue_types`, `customer_events`. Requires the `read:scheduler_analytics` permission.

parameters.name: metrics
parameters.description: Comma-separated metric blocks to include (default: all)

get.description: Summary Simple Scheduler stats for today, this week, and this month. Requires the `read:scheduler_analytics` permission.

Booking requests submitted through Simple Scheduler. Supports offset pagination (`offset` + `limit`, returns `meta.total`) or cursor pagination (`cursor` = `created_at` from a previous page; response includes `next_cursor` and `has_more`). Requires the `read:scheduler_analytics` permission.

parameters.name: has_utm
parameters.description: When `true`, only requests with UTM attribution

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: ISO 8601 `created_at` cursor from a previous page (cursor mode)

st_job_id.description: ServiceTitan job ID when the request produced a job

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page (cursor mode)

get.description: Scheduler configurations for the team. Team is resolved from `x-team-id` or the optional `team_id` query parameter (multi-team keys must have access to that team). Requires the `read:scheduler_analytics` permission.

parameters.name: team_id
parameters.description: Target team (alternative to the x-team-id header for multi-team keys)

get.description: List all teams accessible with this API key. Requires the `read:teams` permission. Internal QA/test teams are excluded by default; pass `include_test_teams=true` to include them.
List scheduler configs for a team. Requires the `read:scheduler_analytics` permission.
List scheduling-widget sessions for a team — a customer's journey from starting a booking to completing it or dropping off. Requires the `read:scheduler_analytics` permission.
Get a single session by ID. Requires the `read:scheduler_analytics` permission.
List bookings for a team — sessions with status `booked`. Same query parameters as sessions, minus `status`. Requires the `read:scheduler_analytics` permission.
Get a single booking by session ID. Returns 404 if the session exists but is not booked. Requires the `read:scheduler_analytics` permission.

parameters.name: bookingId
parameters.description: The session ID of the booking

get.description: Funnel metrics with drop-off data. Requires the `read:scheduler_analytics` permission.
UTM attribution data. Same query parameters as funnel. Requires the `read:scheduler_analytics` permission.
Distribution of service-area lookups. Same query parameters as funnel. Requires the `read:scheduler_analytics` permission.
Distribution of issue types selected in the scheduler. Same query parameters as funnel. Requires the `read:scheduler_analytics` permission.

The canonical leads feed for one team: the historical/pull counterpart to the `lead.*` event webhooks, including the raw third-party payload. Keyset cursor-paginated ascending by `(created_at, id)`. Leads from registered test phone numbers are excluded by default (`include_test_numbers=true` opts in). Requires the `read:leads` permission.

One row per initial outbound campaign text message, including the customer's first reply. Designed for partners ingesting Avoca outbound activity into a BI warehouse. Always scoped to the team in the URL path. Requires the `read:outbound` permission.

Customer events over time (multiple rows per customer): outbound messages and subscription (opt-in/opt-out) changes. Subscription events reflect each phone's *current* state, timestamped by its last change — at most one subscription event per phone. Requires the `read:outbound` permission.

The canonical leads feed across every team (brand) in the enterprise. Requires an `enterprise_all_teams` key whose enterprise matches the path — single-team and portfolio keys receive 403. Every row carries `team_id`. Same query parameters as the single-team feed. Requires the `read:leads` permission.

Sessions across all teams accessible to a multi-team key. Supports the same query parameters as the team-scoped endpoint, plus an optional `team_id` filter. Requires the `read:scheduler_analytics` permission.
Bookings across all teams accessible to a multi-team key. Requires the `read:scheduler_analytics` permission.
Aggregated funnel data across all teams accessible to a multi-team key, with an optional `team_id` filter. Requires the `read:scheduler_analytics` permission.

bearerAuth.description: API key in the format `avoca_<64 hex characters>`

xTeamId.name: x-team-id
xTeamId.description: Target team ID. Required for multi-team (`enterprise_all_teams` / `portfolio_all_teams`) keys on v0 endpoints; single-team keys are locked to their team and omit it.

cursor.name: cursor
cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from the previous response's `pagination.cursor`

startDate.name: start_date
startDate.description: Only rows on/after this ISO 8601 timestamp

endDate.name: end_date
endDate.description: Only rows before this ISO 8601 timestamp

startDate7d.name: start_date
startDate7d.description: Start of date range (ISO 8601; default 7 days ago)

endDateNow.name: end_date
endDateNow.description: End of date range (ISO 8601; default now)

timezone.name: timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone for date calculations (default America/New_York)

includeTestTeams.name: include_test_teams
includeTestTeams.description: Include designated internal QA/test teams in multi-team aggregations (default false)

leadsIncludeRaw.name: include_raw
leadsIncludeRaw.description: When `false`, omit the `raw` third-party payload field (default true)

leadsIncludeTestNumbers.name: include_test_numbers
leadsIncludeTestNumbers.description: When `true`, include leads from the team's registered test phone numbers (default false)

Forbidden.description: API key lacks the required permission or team access

cursor.description: Pass back as the `cursor` query parameter to fetch the next page; `null` on the last page

Call.description: A call record. The exact columns returned on list endpoints are governed by the team's configured column allowlist; the fields below are the standard set.

booking_result.description: Computed from `is_booked` and `is_bookable`: Booked = call resulted in a booking; Unbooked = bookable but not booked; Excused = not a bookable opportunity

agent.description: Assistant ID that handled the touchpoint

LeadV1.description: A canonical lead record — the pull counterpart to the `lead.*` event webhooks.

contacted.description: Whether any outreach touchpoint has occurred for this lead

not_contacted_reason.description: Why the lead has not been contacted, when `contacted` is false

bookings.description: Bookings attributed to this lead, deduped by CRM job ID and sorted earliest-first

booked_job_id.description: CRM job ID of the first booking, when present

CoachCall.description: An evaluated coach (QA) call. `evaluation_answers` maps rubric item keys to "Yes" / "No" / "N/A" — join to `GET /api/coach/rubrics` via `rubric_id` for item names.

SchedulerAnalytics.description: Metric blocks are present only when requested via the `metrics` parameter (default: all).

customerEvents.description: Individual customer sessions with PII (paginated via `limit`/`offset`)

Session.description: A customer's journey through the scheduling widget — from starting a booking to completing it or dropping off.

st_job_id.description: ServiceTitan job ID when the booking created a job

customer_response.description: Body of the customer's first inbound reply, else `no response`
